label: The leaning-cards observation attacks the unrestricted holding per se link
note: Target: the unrestricted holding per se link 685933c7, which since #2103 lane E batch 7 is on a root route through cf7940a7 and 5eb16c61. Mechanism: two cards leaning on each other each presently hold the other in act in the same respect, and each is MOTION_3 held in the act by which it holds, so the link makes each a per se link of the other; with the holding regress 6f924bb0 that series a, b, a, b, ... is excluded (noMutualHolding, result 0b40c6e1, conclusion f401994a). Independent justification: ordinary statics, where each card's propped position is held by the contact force the other now exerts. Relevance: the attack bears on the original support of cf7940a7 (result 7263cb1a); the total-holding repair (4b9462dd, b41f6bcd, 6fdb45c3) gives cf7940a7 a support consistent with the cards. The regress premise, not the link, could instead be the member to go; the inconsistency forces rejecting at least one of the three, not a preferred one.
